svg.text: 16-st × 28-rnd repeat · cells drawn at gauge proportions (22 sts × 30 rnds = 10 cm)
Worked in the round: read every round right to left, from rnd 1 at the bottom.
CO 64 sts, work 2x2 rib 2 cm, then chart (4 repeats per rnd), rib 2 cm, BO.
Each cell is wider than tall like a real stitch, so the chart shows the beans
as they will appear in the fabric (≈3.4 × 2.3 cm ovals with an S-shaped crease).
